question.text: The maximum timeline under SEBI PM Regs for grievance redressal is:

explanation.text: The Logic: Under the SEBI investor-grievance framework that portfolio managers are required to follow (SCORES / ODR / investor-charter timelines), the standard outer limit for first-level grievance redressal by an intermediary is 21 calendar days. Anything still unresolved at that point escalates through SCORES or online dispute-resolution channels. The Trap: 7 days is shorter than what SEBI mandates as the redressal window; 30 and 90 calendar days are longer than the investor-charter standard and would not satisfy SEBI's timeliness expectations. Note: The NISM-Series-XXI-B workbook (pp. 133, 152-153, 200, 210) supports redressal 'within the time stipulated by SEBI' and discusses SCORES / ODR / investor-charter timelines generally, but does not state a 21-calendar-day maximum in the pages checked. The 21-day framing above is drawn from the general SEBI investor-grievance regime rather than from a workbook citation.
